dependencyRationale: Photo picking is native, canonical ownership and restart restoration cross private file storage plus SQLDelight, component state carries stable identity, and Compose renders/edit actions on both targets.
fallbackReason: The current implementation stores a temporary import path as PhotoId, so the correction necessarily crosses platform picker, data transaction, component model and UI adapter boundaries.
toolchainIdentity: Gradle wrapper 9.5.1; JDK 17; Kotlin 2.4.10; Compose Multiplatform 1.12.0; Android SDK 37; iOS Simulator Kotlin/Native target
